DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 会場のご案内で、何をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: What are you looking for in the venue information?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 子どもが途中で帰りたくなったら、私だけ連れて帰ります。友人とは別になるので、帰る前に会える所を決めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 子どもと途中帰宅する場合の友人連絡場所を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: If my child wants to go home partway through, I will take them home on my own. I will be separating from my friend, so I want to agree on somewhere we can meet before leaving.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Discuss in Japanese a place to contact or meet your friend if you go home early with your child.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この案内所を、待ち合わせの目印にしていただけます。看板はお分かりになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can use this information booth as a meeting landmark. Can you identify the sign?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 青い看板の案内所ですね。友人にも、今この場所を見てもらっておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 青い案内所看板を待合せ目印として友人へ共有する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: The information booth with the blue sign, correct? I will have my friend look at this location now too.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Share in Japanese the blue information-booth sign with your friend as the meeting landmark.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お友達への連絡方法はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do you have a way to contact your friend?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 電話はありますが、音が大きい時は気づかないかもしれません。帰る時は短いメッセージも送ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 音で通話に気づかない場合にメッセージも送る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have a phone, but they may not notice a call when it is loud. When leaving, I will send a short message too.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will also send a message in case noise prevents your friend from noticing a call.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お子様と一緒に移動し、混雑している場所へ戻って探し回らないようにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Move together with your child, and avoid returning to crowded areas to search around.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 子どもと一緒にここへ来ます。帰る時の出口も、先に教えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 子どもと一緒に案内所へ来る予定を伝え出口を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will come here together with my child. Could you also tell me the exit to use when leaving, in advance?
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you plan to come to the information booth with your child and ask about the exit.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 会場の出口は、この案内図に示されています。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: The venue exits are shown on this map.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 案内所と出口を確認できました。今のうちに友人へ、途中で帰る時は子どもとここへ来て連絡すると伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 目印出口を確認し途中退出連絡方法を友人へ伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have checked the information booth and exit. I will tell my friend now that if we leave early, I will come here with my child and contact them.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you have checked the landmark and exit and will tell your friend how you will contact them when leaving early.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、お二人でお気をつけて。花火をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please both take care. Enjoy the fireworks.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 歯ブラシをお探しでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for a toothbrush?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。いつも使うのは「ふつう」ですが、同じ色が二種類あって迷っています。違いを教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同じ色の二種類の歯ブラシの違いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I normally use medium, but there are two kinds in the same color, so I am unsure. Please explain the difference.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese about the difference between two toothbrush types of the same color.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらは「ふつう」、隣は「かため」です。硬さの表示をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: This one is medium, and the one beside it is firm. Please look at the firmness label.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 色では区別できないのですね。ふつうの方を買いますが、一本入りはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: ふつうを選び一本入りの有無を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: So color does not distinguish them. I will buy the medium one, but do you have a single pack?
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Choose medium and ask in Japanese whether a one-brush pack is available.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今、こちらにあるふつうの商品は二本入りです。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: The medium toothbrushes we currently have here come in packs of two.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 二本入りでも大丈夫です。一本は予備にします。二本でこの値札の金額ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 予備を含む二本を購入し包み単位の価格を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: A two-pack is fine. I will keep one as a spare. Is the amount on this price tag for both?
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will buy two including a spare and confirm the price is per package.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、この包み一つの値段です。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, it is the price for this one package.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。見本の持ち手は細く見えますね。袋の中の商品も同じ形でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 見本と販売品の持ち手の形が同じか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. The sample's handle looks thin. Is the product inside the package the same shape?
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether the handle shape is the same on the sample and the product for sale.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの見本と同じ型の商品です。袋の表示でも型を確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: It is the same model as this sample. You can also check the model on the package label.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 型と硬さを確認できました。この二本入りを一つお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 型と硬さを確かめ二本入り一包を注文する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have checked the model and firmness. I would like one of these two-packs, please.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you have checked the model and firmness and order one package containing two toothbrushes.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、こちらをどうぞ。お買い上げありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here you are, then. Thank you for your purchase.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今回の説明で、ご確認されたいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything you would like to check about today's explanation?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。同居の友人にも同じ税金の通知が来ています。今日の説明をそのまま伝えてよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同居友人の通知にも自分への税相談回答を使えるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. My friend who lives with me also received a notice for the same tax. May I pass along today's explanation exactly as it is?
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether the answer to your own tax consultation can also be used for your housemate's notice.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご友人の場合も、その方の状況を確認する必要があります。お仕事なども同じでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: For your friend too, their own circumstances need to be checked. Is their employment and so on the same?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 勤務先も収入も違います。住所が同じなので、同じ答えになると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 勤務先収入が違い同住所で同じ回答と考えたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Our workplaces and incomes differ. Since our address is the same, I had thought the answer would be the same.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that your workplaces and incomes differ, but you thought the same address meant the same answer.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今日の回答は、お客様の資料についての説明です。ご友人の結論には使えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Today's answer explains your own documents. It cannot be used as a conclusion for your friend.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。相談できる窓口を紹介したいのですが、友人に渡せる案内はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人条件で別相談するため友人へ渡す窓口案内を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I would like to introduce a consultation desk to them. Is there information I can give my friend?
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for desk information to give your friend so they can consult separately based on their own circumstances.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの案内をお持ちください。受付時間と問い合わせ先が書かれています。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please take this guide. It lists reception hours and inquiry contact details.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。友人は平日仕事なので、まずこの番号へ相談の方法を聞くよう伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 平日勤務の友人へ電話で相談方法を確認するよう伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. My friend works on weekdays, so I will tell them first to ask this number how to arrange a consultation.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will tell your friend who works weekdays to phone and check how to consult.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お問い合わせの時には、どの通知についての相談かお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: When making the inquiry, please explain which notice the consultation concerns.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 通知を手元に用意して電話するよう話します。私の回答とは分けて、本人の条件で相談してもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 通知を用意し本人の条件で相談するよう紹介する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will tell them to have the notice ready when calling. I will have them consult based on their own circumstances, separately from my answer.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will suggest having the notice ready and consulting based on the friend's own circumstances.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、案内とご自身の資料をお持ち帰りください。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please take the guide and your own documents home with you. Please excuse me.

DLG-SC-AIC-KARIYA-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-AIC-KARIYA-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今日の日報で、確認したい所はありますか。
DLG-SC-AIC-KARIYA-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything you would like to check in today's daily report?

DLG-SC-AIC-KARIYA-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-AIC-KARIYA-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 停止時間の欄に三十分と書こうとしました。でも、その三十分は全員の昼休みです。故障の停止と一緒に書くのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-AIC-KARIYA-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 休憩三十分を故障停止欄へ入れるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-AIC-KARIYA-001-SHARED-02.translation: I was going to write thirty minutes in the downtime field. But those thirty minutes were everyone's lunch break. Should I write it together with stoppages due to breakdowns?
DLG-SC-AIC-KARIYA-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether the thirty-minute break should go in the breakdown-downtime field.

DLG-SC-AIC-KARIYA-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-AIC-KARIYA-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この日報では、予定された休憩と設備の異常停止を別に記録します。異常で止まった時間もありましたか。
DLG-SC-AIC-KARIYA-001-SHARED-03.translation: In this daily report, scheduled breaks and abnormal equipment stoppages are recorded separately. Was there also time stopped because of an abnormality?

DLG-SC-AIC-KARIYA-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-AIC-KARIYA-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 午後に五分止まりました。担当者が対応した間、私は作業を待っていました。昼休みとは別です。
DLG-SC-AIC-KARIYA-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 午後の異常停止五分と休憩を区別して伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-AIC-KARIYA-001-SHARED-04.translation: It stopped for five minutes in the afternoon. While the person in charge dealt with it, I was waiting to work. That was separate from lunch break.
DLG-SC-AIC-KARIYA-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish in Japanese the five-minute abnormal stoppage in the afternoon from the break.

DLG-SC-AIC-KARIYA-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-AIC-KARIYA-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、休憩三十分と異常停止五分を、それぞれの欄へ書いてください。異常の内容は把握していますか。
DLG-SC-AIC-KARIYA-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then write the thirty-minute break and five-minute abnormal stoppage in their respective fields. Do you know what the abnormality was?

DLG-SC-AIC-KARIYA-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-AIC-KARIYA-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 担当者が何を直したかまでは聞いていません。原因を推測して故障名を書かず、停止の時刻と待った事実を書きたいです。
DLG-SC-AIC-KARIYA-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 修理原因を推測せず時刻と待機の事実を書くと提案する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-AIC-KARIYA-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have not heard exactly what the person in charge repaired. Rather than guess the cause and write a breakdown name, I want to write the stopping time and the fact that I waited.
DLG-SC-AIC-KARIYA-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Propose in Japanese writing the time and fact of waiting without guessing the cause of the repair.

DLG-SC-AIC-KARIYA-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-AIC-KARIYA-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 原因は担当者に確認してから補いましょう。完成数の欄も、記録票と合っているか見せてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-AIC-KARIYA-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us add the cause after confirming it with the person in charge. Could you also show me whether the completed-quantity field matches the record sheet?

DLG-SC-AIC-KARIYA-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-AIC-KARIYA-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 完成数は記録票の百二十個です。こちらへ写した数字も百二十になっています。
DLG-SC-AIC-KARIYA-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 記録票の百二十個と日報の完成数を照合する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-AIC-KARIYA-001-SHARED-08.translation: The completed quantity is the one hundred twenty units on the record sheet. The number I copied here is also one hundred twenty.
DLG-SC-AIC-KARIYA-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Compare in Japanese the one hundred twenty units on the record sheet with the completed quantity in the daily report.

DLG-SC-AIC-KARIYA-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-AIC-KARIYA-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 数は合っています。あとは休憩と異常停止を分けた記入を見せてください。
DLG-SC-AIC-KARIYA-001-SHARED-09.translation: The quantity matches. Now please show me the entries with the break and abnormal stoppage separated.

DLG-SC-AIC-KARIYA-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-AIC-KARIYA-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 休憩三十分、異常停止五分と書きました。原因の欄は担当者に聞いてから仕上げます。
DLG-SC-AIC-KARIYA-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 区別した日報と原因未確認を示し担当確認後の提出を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-AIC-KARIYA-001-SHARED-10.translation: I wrote thirty minutes of break and five minutes of abnormal stoppage. I will finish the cause field after asking the person in charge.
DLG-SC-AIC-KARIYA-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Show in Japanese the report with the times separated and the cause unconfirmed, and decide to submit after checking with the person in charge.

DLG-SC-AIC-KARIYA-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-AIC-KARIYA-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: この区別で確認を進めます。それでは、今日の記録を持って担当者の所へどうぞ。お疲れさまでした。
DLG-SC-AIC-KARIYA-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will proceed with checking on that basis. Please take today's record to the person in charge. Thank you for your work today.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 修理のご相談ですか。お持ちの物を拝見します。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you here about a repair? Let me see what you brought.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家で使う電動ドリルです。昨日からいつもと違う音がしたので、使うのをやめました。買い替える前に修理費を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 異音で使用をやめたドリルの買替え前の修理費見積を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: It is an electric drill I use at home. It started making an unusual noise yesterday, so I stopped using it. Before replacing it, I would like to know the repair cost.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for a repair estimate before replacing a drill you stopped using because of unusual noise.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらでは原因をその場で判断せず、修理担当へ見積りを依頼できます。購入を確認できる物はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Rather than determine the cause on the spot here, we can request an estimate from the repair team. Do you have proof of purchase?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この店で買った時のレシートも持って来ました。購入日はここに書いてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 購入日が分かるレシートを提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I also brought the receipt from when I bought it at this store. The purchase date is written here.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show in Japanese the receipt displaying the purchase date.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お預かりする本体と、お持ちの付属品を確認します。こちらは充電器ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will check the main unit we are taking and the accessories you brought. This is the charger, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 本体と充電器です。説明書は家にありますが、それも必要でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本体と充電器を示し説明書も必要か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: The main unit and charger. The instruction manual is at home; is that needed too?
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the main unit and charger and ask in Japanese whether the instruction manual is also needed.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今日はこの二点で受け付けます。見積りの結果をご連絡し、ご了解をいただいてから修理に進みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will accept these two items today. We will contact you with the estimate and proceed with repairs after obtaining your agreement.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 見積りを聞く前に修理が始まらないよう、その希望を残してください。高ければ買い替えるか、自分で考えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 見積前に修理開始せず金額を見て判断したいと求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please record my wish that repairs not begin before I hear the estimate. If it is expensive, I want to decide for myself whether to replace it.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese that repairs not start before the estimate and say you want to decide after seeing the cost.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 見積り後に判断と記録しました。預り票の品名と二点をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: I have recorded that you will decide after the estimate. Please check the item name and the two items on the collection slip.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 品名も、本体と充電器の二点も合っています。預り票を保管し、連絡を受けてから修理を頼むか決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 預り二品と品名を照合し控え保管後の連絡で判断する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: The item name and both the main unit and charger are correct. I will keep the slip and decide whether to request repairs after I hear from you.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Compare in Japanese the two items and product name, keep the receipt slip, and say you will decide after being contacted.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お預かりしました。それでは、見積りの連絡をお待ちください。ご来店ありがとうございました。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: We have received them. Please wait for us to contact you with the estimate. Thank you for visiting. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 問診票のこちらの欄は、生活で困っていることをご記入ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: In this field on the medical questionnaire, please write what causes difficulty in daily life.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 右の肩が痛いとは書きましたが、困ることも同じ言葉でよいですか。服を着る時に腕を上げにくいことも伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 右肩痛と服着用時の腕挙上困難を困る動作欄に書くか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I wrote that my right shoulder hurts, but should I use the same words for the difficulties too? I also want to explain that it is hard to raise my arm when getting dressed.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether to write right shoulder pain and difficulty raising your arm when dressing in the field for difficult movements.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 困る動作を具体的に書いて、診察でご説明ください。いつからその動作が難しくなりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Write the specific movements that are difficult and explain them during the examination. When did that movement become difficult?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 三日前からです。袖へ右腕を通す時に困ります。何も動かしていない時の様子とは分けて書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 三日前からの右袖動作と安静時を分けて説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Three days ago. I have difficulty putting my right arm through a sleeve. I will write that separately from how it feels when I am not moving anything.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese the right-arm sleeve movement that became difficult three days ago, separately from the condition at rest.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 三日前から、袖を通す時に困るのですね。問診票のこの欄に、そのまま書いていただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: So putting your arm through a sleeve has been difficult for three days. You can write exactly that in this field on the questionnaire.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ここに書きます。仕事は机に向かうことが多いのですが、それも診察で話した方がよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 机に向かう仕事の様子も診察で話すか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will write it here. My work involves sitting at a desk a lot; should I mention that during the examination too?
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether to describe your desk-based work during the medical examination as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お仕事の様子も診察でお話しください。ほかに困っている動作はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please also describe your work during the examination. Are there any other movements causing difficulty?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 高い棚に物を戻す時も痛みます。言葉だけで伝わるか心配なのですが、受付で動かして見せる必要はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 棚へ物を戻す時の痛みを補足し受付で実演が必要か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: It also hurts when putting things back on a high shelf. I am worried whether words alone explain it; do I need to demonstrate the movement at reception?
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Add in Japanese that putting things back on a shelf hurts and ask whether a demonstration at reception is needed.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 受付では動作を試していただく必要はありません。記入が終わりましたら、ご提出ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: You do not need to try the movement at reception. Please submit the form after you finish writing.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 右の肩の痛みと、袖に腕を通すこと、高い棚のことを書きました。三日前からと添え、この用紙を出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 痛み二動作と三日前の期間を記入して提出する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I wrote about the right shoulder pain, putting my arm through a sleeve, and the high shelf. I will add that it started three days ago and submit this form.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will write the pain, the two movements, and the onset three days ago, then submit the form.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 用紙をお預かりします。それでは、診察で詳しい様子をお話しください。お大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will take the form. Please explain the details during the examination. Take care of yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ち帰りのお弁当でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this a takeaway boxed meal?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 夜勤へ持って行きます。休憩が二回に分かれるので、ご飯とおかずを別の容器にできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 夜勤の二回の休憩に合わせご飯とおかずの別容器を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I will take it to my night shift. My break is split into two, so could the rice and side dishes be in separate containers?
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Discuss in Japanese separate containers for rice and side dishes to suit two breaks during your night shift.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この弁当は一つの容器でお渡ししています。別売りのご飯とおかずなら、容器が分かれます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: This boxed meal comes in one container. If you buy rice and side dishes sold separately, the containers will be separate.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一つの弁当を分け直すのではなく、別の商品を選ぶのですね。おかずだけの商品はどれですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 弁当の分割ではなく別売商品を選ぶと理解しておかずを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: So I should select separate products rather than have one boxed meal divided up again. Which product is just the side dish?
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you understand you should choose separately sold products rather than split a boxed meal, and ask about side dishes.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの焼き魚のおかずです。ご飯は小と普通があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: This is the grilled fish side dish. Rice comes in small and regular sizes.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 焼き魚のおかず一つと、小のご飯一つにします。二つの容器を同じ袋へ入れてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 焼き魚のおかずと小ご飯を一つずつ同袋で頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will have one grilled fish side dish and one small rice. Please put the two containers in the same bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Order in Japanese one grilled fish side dish and one small rice, together in one bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その組合せで六百円です。持ち帰った後の保存は、商品の表示をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: That combination is six hundred yen. After taking it away, please check the product label for storage information.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 六百円でお願いします。容器のどこに保存の表示がありますか。夜勤の休憩が遅れることもあるので、見ておきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 六百円を確認し夜勤に持つ商品の保存表示の位置を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Six hundred yen, please. Where on the container is the storage information? My night-shift break is sometimes delayed, so I want to check it.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm six hundred yen and ask in Japanese where the storage label is on the food you will take to your night shift.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 容器の表示はこちらです。職場での保管方法も合わせてご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Here is the label on the container. Please also check how it can be stored at your workplace.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 表示はここですね。職場で保管できるかも確かめます。今日はこの二品をお願いします。六百円です。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 表示を読み職場保管確認を引き受け二品六百円で購入する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: The label is here, correct? I will also check whether I can store it at work. I would like these two items today. Here is six hundred yen.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you have read the label and will check storage at work, and buy the two items for six hundred yen.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 六百円、お預かりしました。二品をこちらの袋でお渡しします。ありがとうございました。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I have received six hundred yen. Here are the two items in this bag. Thank you very much. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 応募先から面接候補の連絡が来ました。火曜の九時か、木曜の十四時です。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: The employer you applied to has contacted us with interview options: Tuesday at nine or Thursday at fourteen hundred.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 火曜は今の職場の夜勤が八時に終わります。九時なら間に合うと思ったのですが、工場から面接先までの移動も必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 夜勤八時終了と火曜九時面接の移動問題を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: My night shift at my current workplace ends at eight on Tuesday. I thought I could make nine, but I also need to travel from the factory to the interview location.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese the travel issue between the night shift ending at eight and a Tuesday nine o'clock interview.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 移動にどのくらいかかる予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: How long do you expect the journey to take?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 電車と徒歩で一時間ほどです。勤務が終わってから着替える時間もあるので、九時に着けるとは言い切れません。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一時間の移動と着替えで到着を約束できないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: About an hour by train and on foot. I also need time to change after work, so I cannot guarantee arriving at nine.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the hour-long journey and changing clothes mean you cannot promise your arrival time.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: もう一つの木曜十四時は、勤務の予定と合いますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Does the other option, Thursday at fourteen hundred, fit your work schedule?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 木曜は休みなので、十四時なら余裕を持って行けます。木曜の方でお願いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 休日木曜十四時を面接希望に選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thursday is my day off, so I can get there with time to spare for fourteen hundred. Could I request Thursday?
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose in Japanese Thursday at fourteen hundred, your day off, as your preferred interview time.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では、木曜十四時を希望すると応募先へ連絡します。持ち物の案内も確認しますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then I will tell the employer that Thursday at fourteen hundred is your preference. I will also check the instructions about what to bring.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。履歴書を持って行くと聞いています。ほかの物も必要なら、応募先の返事と一緒に教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 履歴書以外の持ち物も応募先に確認してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. I have heard I should bring a resume. If anything else is needed, please let me know along with the employer's reply.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for confirmation with the employer of required items besides your resume.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 応募先は履歴書と職務経歴書を持参してほしいそうです。木曜十四時で受け付けるとの返事です。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: The employer would like you to bring a resume and a work-history document. They replied that they can see you Thursday at fourteen hundred.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 木曜十四時、履歴書と職務経歴書ですね。書類を用意して、前日に道順も調べておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確定した木曜十四時と二書類を確認し道順も準備する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thursday at fourteen hundred, a resume, and a work-history document, correct? I will prepare the documents and check the route the day before too.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese the fixed Thursday fourteen-hundred interview and two documents, and say you will prepare the route as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 面接の日時と持ち物をご確認いただけました。それでは、ご準備ください。よい面接になりますように。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: You have confirmed the interview date, time, and required items. Please make your preparations. I hope the interview goes well. Please excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ゲーム機について、お呼びでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Did you call for help with a game machine?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 景品が下へ落ちましたが、出口の上に引っかかって取れません。もう一度遊ぶ前に見ていただきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 出口に景品が引っかかり再プレイ前に確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: The prize fell down, but it is stuck above the outlet and I cannot get it. I would like you to look before I play again.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for a check before playing again because the prize is caught at the outlet.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの機械ですか。こちらへ案内していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Which machine is it? Could you show me the way?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 入口から三台目の、この機械です。黄色い袋が出口の縁に残っています。まだ手を奥へ入れていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 三台目の黄色袋の位置と未接触を具体的に示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: This one, the third machine from the entrance. The yellow bag is still on the edge of the outlet. I have not put my hand deep inside yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Specify in Japanese the third machine, the yellow bag's position, and that you have not reached in to touch it.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: そのままお待ちください。機械を確認して、景品の状態も見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please wait as it is. I will check the machine and the prize's condition.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 遊び終わった直後に呼びました。落ちた時の動画はないのですが、あの黄色い袋です。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 直前のプレイ後に引っかかった黄色い袋を特定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I called you immediately after finishing my turn. I do not have a video of when it fell, but it is that yellow bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Identify in Japanese the yellow bag that got stuck after your most recent play.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 出口で引っかかっていたことを確認しました。獲得した景品として、こちらからお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: I have confirmed that it was caught at the outlet. We will give it to you as a prize you won.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。引っぱっても取れなさそうで困っていました。こちらで受け取ればよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 店員の確認後に景品をどこで受け取るか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. I was stuck because it did not look as though pulling would get it out. Should I receive it here?
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: After the staff check, ask in Japanese where you should receive the prize.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、こちらからお渡しします。袋の絵柄もご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, I will hand it to you here. Please also check the design on the bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 黄色い袋に猫の絵ですね。取ろうとしていた景品と同じです。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 渡された袋の絵柄が機内景品と一致すると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: A cat picture on the yellow bag, correct? It is the same prize I was trying to win. Thank you very much.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that the design on the bag you received matches the prize in the machine.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お受け取りを確認しました。それでは、引き続きお楽しみください。またお困りでしたらお呼びください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I have confirmed you received it. Please continue enjoying your time. Call us again if you have any trouble. Please excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 本をご覧になる場所について、お困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having trouble finding a place to read the book?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この本の地図は横へ大きく開きます。今の机では隣の人の所まで出るので、広く使える台を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 折込地図が隣席へはみ出すため広い閲覧台を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: The map in this book folds out wide sideways. At my current desk, it extends into the next person's space, so please tell me where there is a larger reading table.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for a large reading table because a foldout map extends into the neighboring seat.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 窓側に大きい閲覧台があります。地図を開く前に、本を閉じて移動できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: There is a large reading table by the window. Can you close the book and move there before opening the map?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 閉じて移動します。地図の端を手で持って歩かず、折り目に沿って元の位置へ戻してから、本ごと持ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 折り目へ閉じて端だけ持たず本全体で移動すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will close it before moving. I will not walk holding the edge of the map; I will fold it back into place along its creases and carry the whole book.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will fold it closed along the creases and move the whole book rather than hold only the map's edge.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: そのようにお願いします。閲覧台では、地図全体が台の上に載ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please do that. The entire map will fit on the reading table.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 載る大きさですね。荷物も地図の上には置かず、横のかばん置場へ入れたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 全体支持の台を確認し荷物は別置場へ入れたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: So it is large enough to support it. I would also like to put my belongings in the bag storage beside it, not on top of the map.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that the table supports the whole map and say you want to put your belongings in separate storage.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: かばん置場をお使いください。折り目が開きにくい時は、無理に引かずお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please use the bag storage. If a fold is difficult to open, let us know rather than pull it forcefully.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この折り目は少し固いです。強く引っぱる前に、開く時に見ていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 固い折り目を無理に引かず開く補助を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: This fold is a little stiff. Could you help me check it when opening, before I pull hard?
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for help opening a stiff fold without forcing it.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらで一緒に開きます。紙の端まで台に載せてご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will open it together here. Please read it with the paper supported on the table right up to its edges.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 全体を載せられました。隣の席を使わずに読めます。読み終えたら、同じ折り目で閉じて返却台へ置きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 台上で全体を読み終えたら同じ折り目で閉じ返却台へ置く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have the whole map on the table. I can read it without using the neighboring seat. When finished, I will fold it along the same creases and put it on the returns table.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that after reading the whole map supported on the table, you will close it along the same folds and put it on the returns table.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ごゆっくりご覧ください。それでは、お困りの際はお声がけください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take your time reading. Let us know if you need help. Please excuse me.
